title: Make `LightmapData` smaller and manually pack `uses_lightmap_specular` into element info.
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Small follow-up to #109737.

- The `specular_intensity` field caused the `LightmapData` struct to extend to 80 bytes. To bring it back to 64 bytes, we can utilize the padding space that has always been available in the `normal_xform` field.
- The `uses_lightmap_specular` field in element info causes a redundant memory store to be generated by the compiler. To avoid it, we can manually bit shift and OR it into the `uint32_t` rvalue. The generated code becomes the same as before, just without the redundant store.

## Additional information

N/A.
